simple.meaning: עׇזְנִיָּה (ʻoznîyâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “probably the sea-eagle (from its strength).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עׇזְנִיָּה (H5822) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 11:13, with occurrences in Leviticus, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עׇזְנִיָּה (H5822) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עׇזְנִיָּה (H5822) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עׇזְנִיָּה (ʻoznîyâh) / H5822 is traced through Leviticus 11:13, Deuteronomy 14:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
